name: agent_incident_handler
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 9 - Detecta imprevisto en obra, gpt-4o-mini genera 2 opciones {coste,dias,ventajas,desventajas} + comunicacion al cliente. POST /api/v1/agents/incident-handler/run con JWT. INSERT project_incidents status=proposed + notify architect.
_status: B9 (PLAN V1.0 ejecucion). Text-only V1 (vision en V1.1).

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
),
proj AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.current_phase, p.location_city, p.location_address, p.tenant_id,
         p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.project_type,
         c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
  FROM projects p
  JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
  WHERE p.id = $4::uuid
  LIMIT 1
),
cost AS (
  SELECT total_estimated, version
  FROM cost_estimates
  WHERE project_id = $4::uuid
  ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT proj.*, cost.total_estimated AS cost_baseline_eur, cost.version AS cost_version
FROM proj LEFT JOIN cost ON true;

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_incident_handler', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id
